forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M242
do not replace proof gates with objective values
do not use sampled fixed-batch objective as the only promotion signal for tiny corpora
hypothesis: Small M232/M223 corpora need a deterministic full-corpus outcome objective evaluator. Adding it to the harness will make future PPO/interpolation promotion decisions less sensitive to sampled fixed-batch noise.
success_criteria: implement an exact full-corpus outcome objective evaluation path
reproduce the M241 exact-loss comparison for M224 M237 M239 and M240
pre-register the next bounded PPO or objective-direction screen after the evaluator exists
failure_criteria: silently mix sampled and exact objective metrics

commands.name: m242_implement
commands.command: Add deterministic full-corpus outcome objective evaluation and tests, then validate the research harness without PPO.

decision_rule: M242 may only unblock more PPO if exact full-corpus objective evaluation is implemented, tested, and documented without changing actor inputs.
